authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL vānara gives both bānar and bā̃dar-type monkey reflexes, Oriya bāndara, Hindi bā̃dar/bā̃drā, Marwari bā̃dro and Gujarati vā̃dar/vā̃drɔ. The selected Bengali/Bishnupriya banor/banoɾ/bador, Bhatri bẽdṛa/bendṛa/be̩ndra and western/Tharu banḍar/baṇḍro/baṇḍorõ/bənḍra forms belong to this family. Preserve the eastern front-vowel notation, presence or absence of nasal spelling, dental/retroflex stops, schwa and final nasalization. These phonological qualifications and local IA transmission remain open; no new etymon or single borrowing route is asserted. The b(u)y-/buj- family and mixed monkey responses are excluded. Exact response: bador.
